outputs.title:0: Can Ali G: Who Iz I? save character comedy cinema?
outputs.excerpt:0: Sacha Baron Cohen’s new film risks being outdated in a more rancorous era. But could it restore the personality-driven genre to big screens or end it altogether? For a man whose campaign slogan was once “Keep it real”, Ali G has his work cut out in the reality of 2026. The big…
